atoms.text: A local zoo recently recorded all the weights of their lemurs in kilograms, rounded to the nearest quarter of a kilo. This bar chart shows the data they collected.

instruction.text: Listen to the statements and pick the one that is true.

b.sound: The heaviest lemur at the zoo is 3 kilograms.
The heaviest lemur at the zoo is 2.75 kilograms.
The lightest lemur at the zoo is 1.5 kilograms.
The lightest lemur at the zoo is 1.75 kilograms.
There are four lemurs who weigh 2.75 kilograms.
There are five lemurs who weigh 2.75 kilograms.
There are four lemurs who weigh less than 2.25 kilograms.
There are three lemurs who weigh less than 2.25 kilograms.

atoms.text: The zoo also weighed all their prairie dogs. The results are shown in the bar chart above.

instruction.text: Listen to the statements and pick the one that is true.

b.sound: The weights of the prairie dogs range from 0.2 kilograms to 1.6 kilograms.
The weights of the prairie dogs range from half a kilogram to 1.6 kilograms.
Six prairie dogs weigh more than one kilogram.
Seven prairie dogs weigh more than one kilogram.
Twelve prairie dogs weigh less than 0.8 kilograms.
Seven prairie dogs weigh less than 0.8 kilograms.
